summary: A compact, actor-led domestic beat with a clean emotional turn: reassurance becomes dread, and the mother's two-word response provides the release. The letter sounds personal rather than expository, and the family knows only what it plausibly could know.

performance.delivery: She sounds out her brother's words for her mother, proud to be reading but alert to the tension beside her. Keep the pauses natural, not tearful.

lines.speaker: MOSTAFA
issues: The second «ادْعِيلِي» lacks the initial kasra of «اِدْعِيلِي», a minor vocalization omission.

performance.emotion: brave reassurance giving way to need
performance.delivery: He is composing the letter to calm his mother, keeping a young man's steady warmth through the family details. On «ادْعِيلِي كِتِيرْ», let the courage thin slightly without breaking into fear.

lines.text: «…مَا تِقْلَقِيشْ عَلَيَّا. عَمّْ سَيِّدْ وِالرِّجَّالَةْ وَاخْدِينْ بَالْهُمْ مِنِّي. سَلِّمِيلِي عَلَى زِينَبْ، وِقُولِيلْهَا تْذَاكِرْ. وِادْعِيلِي يَا أُمِّي… ادْعِيلِي كِتِيرْ.»

lines.speaker: ZEINAB
issues: Both instances of «يُومْ» should be vocalized «يَوْمْ».

performance.delivery: She reads the date, makes the connection, then tells her mother without looking away from the page. Leave a small stunned gap before the final phrase; do not sob.

lines.text: يَامَّا… دَهْ مَكْتُوبْ يُومْ سِتَّةْ… يُومْ مَا الْحَرْبْ قَامِتْ.

performance.delivery: She gives the letter back as if hearing his words again can keep him present. It is a mother's insistence, not a barked command, with no visible collapse.
